issues.issue: Whether the claimant's fear is linked to a Convention ground (section 96)
issues.applicant_position: Claimant fears Los Zetas extortion, vengeance and death after the 2009 robbery and truck retrieval.
issues.result_text: Fear stems from criminality, not a Convention ground; section 96 does not apply.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces torture under paragraph 97(1)(a)
issues.result_text: Paragraph 97(1)(a) does not apply because the state is not involved in the harm feared.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces a personal risk to life or cruel treatment under paragraph 97(1)(b), not generalized
issues.applicant_position: Los Zetas can find him, want money or vengeance, and would extort or kill him if he returns.
issues.result_text: Any risk to life is a generalized risk under subparagraph 97(1)(b)(ii); the claim is rejected.
